company.name: Extreme Networks
company.shortDescription: Extreme Networks provides wired and wireless networking solutions to enhance connectivity for businesses and organizations.
company.description: Extreme Networks of Santa Clara, Calif., founded in 1996, is a publicly listed company that designs, builds, and installs sophisticated Ethernet solutions that meet the toughest challenges in network connectivity and IP-based communications.

productsAndServices.description: An integrated networking platform that combines AI, network management, security, and support workflows across wired, wireless, fabric, SD-WAN, and third-party infrastructure.

productsAndServices.description: A network fabric solution that automates and secures connectivity across campus, data center, branch, and operational technology environments.

productsAndServices.description: A portfolio of wired networking infrastructure spanning edge and core connectivity for enterprise, campus, branch, data center, and operational technology environments.

productsAndServices.name: Network Security
